claims: As of March 20, 2026, Sanae Takaichi is the Prime Minister of Japan.
Sanae Takaichi took office as Prime Minister of Japan on October 21, 2025.
Sanae Takaichi is the first female leader of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP).
Sanae Takaichi is the first woman to hold the position of Prime Minister of Japan.
Sanae Takaichi previously held cabinet positions under Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.
Sanae Takaichi previously held cabinet positions under Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
Sanae Takaichi met with U.S. President Donald Trump in March 2026 to discuss security, the US-Japan alliance, and conflicts in the Middle East.
Shigeru Ishiba served as Prime Minister of Japan from October 1, 2024 to October 21, 2025.
Fumio Kishida served as Prime Minister of Japan from November 10, 2021 to October 1, 2024.
